change: Minimal baseline, default LightGBM on 7 order-level features.
Added seller features (seller state of first item, same-state flag, number of sellers).
Added seller-to-customer haversine distance (km) from mean geolocation per zip prefix.
Tried product features (first-item category, total weight, max volume); reverted.
Added payment features (max installments, total payment value, number of payments, main payment type).
Tried past-only seller history (seller order count and smoothed late rate, using only orders delivered before each purchase); reverted from FEATS.
Tried calendar features (purchase month, day of month, promised-date weekday); reverted from FEATS.
Regularized LightGBM (300 trees, lr 0.02, 15 leaves, min_child_samples 100, subsampling, L2 5) instead of defaults.
Retried product size features without category (total weight, max package volume); reverted from FEATS.
Averaged 5 LightGBM models trained with different random seeds.
